newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIAN COACH PENEV SIGNS FOR SAUDI ARABIAN CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIAN COACH PENEV SIGNS FOR SAUDI ARABIAN CLUB.

text.p: Bulgaria's former head coach Dimitar Penev, who led the nation to the 1994 World Cup semifinals, has signed with Saudi Arabian club Al-Nassr, a soccer official said on Monday.
Bulgarian soccer league president Valentin Mihov said Penev had signed a one-year contract, with a further one-year option, last Friday. He declined to give further details of the contract.
Under Penev's leadership Bulgaria reached the last four in the World Cup for the first time in their history.
But when the team failed to advance from the group stages of the 1996 European championship, the Bulgarian soccer union decided not to renew Penev's contract.
